title: Grateful Dead Live at Cameron Indoor Stadium, Duke U on 1982-04-02
lineage: Master Soundboard Cassette > Cassette > DAT > CDR

ai_review.summary: Good soundboard capture of a high‑energy Duke gig, featuring a smoking Sugaree and an epic China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider transition.
ai_review.review: The recording is a clean soundboard source that most listeners find well balanced, though the very first song is described as slightly wavy and the channel layout can be confusing if you’re not aware of the new stage positions. Musically the show is remembered as a “smoker” with monster energy – standout moments include Sugaree and one of the best China/Know You Rider transitions ever, while the overall vibe was hot and lively despite a few minor flubs.

ai_rating.rationale: Average star rating ≈4.1 across nine reviews; overwhelmingly positive comments about performance and sound quality, with only minor technical quirks.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear overall mix; first song a bit wavy and channel orientation (Jerry center, Brent right, Bob left) can be confusing if not noted. No major drop‑outs reported.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Above‑average first set and decent second set; strong energy throughout with a memorable prelude to the next night’s Scope Auditorium show.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Often noted for his stage‑right position and praised for the many sweet Jerry tunes that open the set.
band_member_comments.Phil: Described as steady, sub‑sonic bass; this show marks his switch to the opposite side of the stage with Brent.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bobby (Weir) is called good; reviewers discuss his left‑side placement in the mix.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s keyboard is highlighted for being on the right channel after the side swap, but no specific playing remarks are given.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey is observed at the window during the show; drumming receives no detailed commentary.
